name: TS_0070 & TS_0071 - Buyers Page Header - Support Number and Introduction

steps.name: Given the user opens the ExportersIndia Buyers page
Then the header should display one of the support texts "Call us : 9700-318-318, Support : +91-9700318318, 9700-318-318"
When the user scrolls to the bottom of the page and back to the top
Then the header should still display the support text
When the user reloads the Buyers page
Then the header should still display the support text
And the Buyers page should show the introduction "Access verified buy leads and trade leads by industry to connect with serious global buyers and grow your business faster."

parameters.name: introText
parameters.value: Access verified buy leads and trade leads by industry to connect with serious global buyers and grow your business faster.

description:
As a buyer on ExportersIndia
  I want the Buy Leads page to show support details, the For Buyer menu and the industry directory
  So that I can reach support and browse buy leads by industry
